Game Overview

At its heart, Chu Choo Cake is a animal game about guide Piggy the baker through a delightful, yet hazardous kitchen as you fend off mischievous mice intent on stealing your delectable cakes. Employ strategy and precision to outsmart pesky critters and ensure your desserts reach the train on time, all while avoiding the sneaky blue mouse!
